Threat Description: An attacker may attempt to access the application by impersonating an authenticated user.
Test Observation: Unauthenticated API access was rejected and access after logout returned 401 Unauthorized.
Recommended Mitigation: Maintain secure session handling, enforce authentication on protected endpoints, and use secure cookie settings.

Threat Description: An attacker may modify or delete another user's data without permission.
Test Observation: Cross-user task updating was rejected with 404 but cross-user task deletion succeeded with 200 OK.
Recommended Mitigation: Apply ownership validation to every update and delete operation.

Threat Description: A user may deny performing an action if the application does not maintain sufficient audit records.
Test Observation: Audit logging and activity traceability were not evaluated in this test scope.
Recommended Mitigation: Implement audit logs for important actions including task creation, updates, and deletion.

Threat Description: An attacker may gain access to another user's private task information.
Test Observation: User A's attempt to view User B's task was rejected with 404 Not Found. No disclosure was observed in this test.
Recommended Mitigation: Continue enforcing user ownership checks on all data retrieval endpoints and review access controls across the API.

Threat Description: An attacker may overwhelm the application with excessive requests and affect service availability.
Test Observation: The application processed the limited sequential and concurrent test requests without errors. Stress and endurance testing were not performed.
Recommended Mitigation: Apply request rate limiting, monitor resource usage, and conduct further load and stress testing.

Threat Description: A user may perform actions beyond their authorised permissions such as manipulating another user's resources.
Test Observation: User A successfully deleted User B's task demonstrating an authorisation weakness.
Recommended Mitigation: Enforce server-side authorisation and ownership checks before allowing users to modify or delete resources.
